systems.country_label: VitalReg, under the Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (E-CRVS) initiative
systems.platform: online birth and death registration platform, operated under a public-private partnership with Barnksforte Technologies Ltd
systems.tiers: operational in all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory from 1 July 2026; the Commission operates 4,011 registration centres of its own across the 774 local government areas (131 in Anambra's 21) and plans about 8,000

note: The National Population Commission's nationwide digital birth and death registration (live 1 July 2026) runs through the Commission's own 4,011 registration centres located across the 774 local government areas, a national agency's field offices; the local governments' association is named as a partner in decentralising services. No local government office is said to be connected or to work in the system, so no fact.
